# GBAGo: Visual Saves support

> Official support pages for GBAGo, a retro handheld emulator for iPhone and iPad by Lumi Studio. GBAGo contains no games.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6804564400
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.alice51849.GBAGo
